# Date Picker

Choose one available date from week, month, or year views.

## Usage

### Single

Keep one active value while moving and selecting with keyboard or pointer input.

<ComponentExample component="date-picker" scenario="single" title="Single" description="Keep one active value while moving and selecting with keyboard or pointer input." :index="0" />

### Weekdays

Keep every day visible while allowing only weekdays to be selected.

<ComponentExample component="date-picker" scenario="weekdays" title="Weekdays" description="Keep every day visible while allowing only weekdays to be selected." :index="1" />

### Controlled

Let the parent own the current value and apply accepted changes back to the component.

<ComponentExample component="date-picker" scenario="controlled" title="Controlled" description="Let the parent own the current value and apply accepted changes back to the component." :index="2" />

## Floating positioning

This component uses the shared positioning engine. Use the [live positioning example](/guides/positioning) to change `side`, `align`, offsets, collision boundaries, strategy, and tracking while inspecting the resolved placement.

## Style available and selected dates

Style availability and selection from the public ARIA state on calendar cells. You do not need a second visual-only list that can drift from the component policies.

```css
[data-scope='date-picker'][data-part='cell'][aria-selected='true'] {
  background: CanvasText;
  color: Canvas;
}

[data-scope='date-picker'][data-part='cell'][aria-disabled='true'] {
  opacity: .45;
  text-decoration: line-through;
}
```

For SSR or tests that need a stable initial month, set the API `referenceDate` so the first rendered view does not depend on the current clock.

## API reference

See [Date Picker API](/api/components/date-picker) for props, events, slots, public types, part selectors, and keyboard behavior.

## Accessibility

The labeled input and trigger own a calendar grid whose cells expose selected, highlighted, and disabled state.

See the [corresponding WAI-ARIA pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/dialog-modal/examples/datepicker-dialog/) for the host accessibility contract.
